disclaimer: Non-normative companion to docs/specs/player-season-coverage-v0-source-boundary.md. Illustrative field/grain/source shape only. This file does NOT validate data, does NOT authorize implementation, is NOT a dataset, and asserts NO player-season coverage. TIBER-Data has one real player-data season today (2025); no multi-season coverage exists.

row_grain.uniqueness: one row per (player_id, season); duplicate pairs invalid
row_grain.multi_team_season: still ONE row keyed by (player_id, season); multiple teams represented inside the row, never as multiple rows

season_type.note: required on every row (not optional); source spans weeks 1-22 (REG and POST), so unset season_type would let REG/POST/REG+POST totals be silently mixed past a cutoff; not part of the grain, so must be explicit per row; may also be pinned as required artifact-level metadata

primary_team.note: explicit rule (e.g., most weeks observed) recorded in coverage_notes

games_missed.note: absence of a week is NOT a missed game

age_career_context.current_gap: NO populated age/birth_date anywhere; draft data is 2026-only

career_year.formula: season - rookie_year + 1; null if rookie_year unavailable

age_bucket_career_stage.note: never fabricated; age-curve interpretation is out_of_scope (external Age-Curve repo)

availability_boundary.note: coverage/history artifact only; gameday active/inactive/IR belongs to active_player_detection_v0 and player_ownership_v0; roster presence is NOT availability

source_boundary.hard_rule: fixtures/scaffolds are shape references, never truth; no coverage row may derive from a fixture/scaffold and be presented as historical truth

recommended_first_window.season_type_default: first build defaults to producing REG-scoped rows, but season_type is REQUIRED and explicit per row (REG/POST/REG+POST), never implicit
justification: includes 2024+2025: making 2024 real is the prerequisite for Forecast's 2024->2025 target experiment
four seasons give bounded career_year/tenure trend without claiming full career history
recent nflverse seasons have the most consistent weekly usage fields
bounded before full ingestion; broader history is a later separate window
recommended_first_window.minimum_to_unblock_forecast_target: 2024-2025 real player-level coverage; 2024 MUST become real source-backed before Forecast treats 2025 as target
recommended_first_window.later_expansion: full historical toward each player's rookie_year is separate and must not be implied as already available

fail_closed_rules: missing player-season row is not proof of inactivity/out-of-league
missing weeks are not proof of games missed unless source supports it
unavailable usage fields stay null/unavailable, never 0
fixture/scaffold rows cannot be promoted as historical truth
age/career-year cannot be fabricated from missing birth/draft data
multi-team seasons must not be collapsed without explicit primary_team rule
one row per (player_id, season); duplicates invalid
season_type required on every row; REG/POST/REG+POST totals must never be mixed, compared, or fed past a target-season cutoff without explicit season_type (source spans weeks 1-22)
Forecast must not consume until a real artifact passes a separate coverage/provenance gate
forecast_consumer_guidance: a spec is not a dataset
a player-season row is not automatically a Forecast feature
Forecast must not consume player_season_coverage_v0 until a real artifact passes a separate coverage/provenance gate
null/unknown must not be coerced to zero
historical coverage does not imply availability/role/depth-chart/current active status
future Forecast experiments must preserve target-season cutoff rules

relationship_to_lanes.active_player_detection_v0: disjoint axis (availability vs coverage); presence here is not availability there
relationship_to_lanes.player_ownership_v0: reuse provenance/staleness shape, not the status enum
relationship_to_lanes.player_weekly_ppr_outcomes_v1: upstream input; production summaries are deterministic roll-ups
relationship_to_lanes.player_weekly_usage_v1: upstream input; unpopulated weekly fields stay unavailable at season level
relationship_to_lanes.RoleOpportunity: downstream/disjoint; no role interpretation produced here
relationship_to_lanes.age_curve: may carry source-backed season_age/career_year inputs; curve interpretation owned by external Age-Curve repo
relationship_to_lanes.FORGE: observer/shape reference only; no FORGE work
relationship_to_lanes.forecast_runs: history foundation consumed only after a separate gate; not a Run input today

recommended_next_issue.title: feat: build player_season_coverage_v0 for 2022-2025 (bounded, source-bounded, gated)
recommended_next_issue.status: separate, NOT started here, blocked until gates approved
gates: approved season window (default 2022-2025) and approved source list

schema + validator: required identity/season/source enforced; season_type required on every row; missing source_refs fails; unknown/unavailable explicit; zero vs null distinct; multi-team validates only under explicit primary_team rule; invalid grain / duplicate (player_id, season) fails
honest coverage reporting; no age/career fabrication when source lacks birth/draft
no Forecast binding until a later separate coverage/provenance gate passes
